$SONY +27.5%

This is what happens when you seek a fresh, novel idea while everyone is focused on the obvious trades.

PS5 jailbreak thesis is noise. It will not affect GTA sales. 99.9% just want to play this game not hack their console.

70%+ of all GTA 6 orders with flow through $SONY counted as top line revenue and on the next earnings we will see the pre-order numbers show up as receivables.

name: KawzInvests
zh_summary: @KawzInvests 表示，業績前 $META 旗下 Muse 應用的另類數據好壞參半：Sensor Tower 估計截至 10 月 17 日美國下載量達 1,020 萬次，日活躍用戶按週增長 15%，9 月安裝用戶兩週後仍有 23% 回訪，但搜尋熱度已降溫，Meta 亦大舉投放推廣。他估計第三季資本開支為 400 億至 450 億美元，對比全年 1,300 億至 1,450 億美元指引，若使用量持續增長，可能上調指引或接近上限。他指出預期約 100 億美元的第三季法律費用將嚴重拖累帳面盈利，而新墨西哥州 250 億美元判決亦增加不確定性。附圖比較 Muse 與 Grok Bot 的下載量及搜尋熱度。
en_summary: @KawzInvests says alt data on $META's Muse app is mixed into earnings: Sensor Tower estimates 10.2 million US downloads through Oct. 17, daily active users up 15% week over week, and 23% of September installers still returning after two weeks, but search interest has cooled and Meta is spending heavily on promotion. He estimates Q3 capex at $40 to $45 billion against the $130 to $145 billion annual guide and sees a possible raise or a result near the high end if usage keeps growing. He notes the expected roughly $10 billion Q3 legal charge will weigh heavily on reported earnings and that the $25 billion New Mexico ruling adds uncertainty. The charts compare Muse and Grok Bot downloads and search interest.
text:
The alt data on $META’s Muse is mixed heading into earnings.

Sensor Tower estimates 10.2M US downloads through Oct. 17, with daily active users up 15% week over week.

Early retention looks encouraging too. 23% of September installers were still coming back after two weeks. But search interest has cooled, and Meta is spending heavily to promote the app.

Meta’s $130–145B capex guide came before Muse launched. With ~$51B spent in the first half, I’m thinking $40–45B for Q3. If usage keeps growing, I wouldn’t be surprised to see them raise the annual guide or land near the high end.

Meta already expects a ~$10B Q3 legal charge, and today’s $25B New Mexico ruling adds more uncertainty.

The $10B charge alone is going to weigh heavily on reported earnings.

ticker_notes.SPCX: Adam Jonas views neocloud as funding str

zh_summary: 摩根士丹利的Adam Jonas在新的@SpaceX筆記中指出：讓他人為SpaceX最終用於訓練自身機器人的計算基礎設施付費是個好主意，將新雲端建設視為一種融資策略，以利用其在每瓦特每美元每秒智能上的比較優勢。同意Elon認為實體智能經濟具有經濟乘數效應。相信$SPCX改善AI/SI交易公關形象的能力目前被低估。SpaceX正在經歷變革，轉型為垂直整合的全棧AI玩家，而市場仍將其視為具有外大氣層能力的新雲端公司，尚未察覺此變化。
en_summary: Morgan Stanley’s Adam Jonas in new @SpaceX note: Getting others to pay for compute infrastructure that SpaceX will use to train its robots is a good idea, seeing neocloud build as a funding strategy exploiting advantages in intelligence-per-watt-per-$-per-second. Agrees with Elon that Physical Intelligence Economy is economically multiplicative. Believes $SPCX’s ability to improve the PR image of the AI/SI trade is under-appreciated. SpaceX is undergoing a metamorphosis into a vertically-integrated full-stack AI player, undetected by a market that still views it as a neocloud with exo-atmospheric chops.
text:
Morgan Stanley’s Adam Jonas in new @SpaceX note:

“Getting other people to pay for your own compute infrastructure that you will ultimately use to train your own robots is a good idea. We see the neocloud build as more of a 'funding strategy' where SpaceX can exploit its comparative advantages in maximizing  intelligence-per-watt-per-$-per-second relative to peers.

We agree with Elon that the Physical Intelligence Economy (PIE) is economically multiplicative - if not by an order of mag. We believe $SPCX’s ability to help improve the rather challenging PR image of the AI/SI
trade is quite under-appreciated today.

SpaceX is undergoing a metamorphosis largely undetected by a stock market that still views the company as a neocloud with exo-atsmospheric chops, and not a vertically-integrated, full-stack AI player.”
